WORKLOG (task 1, driver_earnings_bonuses_and_payouts, env_0056_ride_hailing_platform)

[Step 0 - draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 4]}. earnings_ext_max_instant_cashout (root) takes 5 factors and earnings_ext_quest_reward_settlement (prerequisite) takes 4.

[Step 0 - scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: earnings_ext_hold_release_payout + lift_payout_hold_7e61ef01 and earnings_ext_guarantee_optin_lock + opt_in_to_guarantee_dc9f134f (events earnings_payout_release with its hold-release payout, and earnings_bonus_optin). Claimed here: earnings_ext_quest_reward_settlement + credit_quest_reward_07fce82e (earnings_bonus_credit) and earnings_ext_max_instant_cashout + cash_out_to_debit_card_82ffed45 (earnings_instant_cashout with its fee row). Nothing remains: the two tasks together cover all four extended policies and all four task tools with no overlap. Task 1's evidence is chosen apart from task 0's within its own tree: the cashout's daily limit reads Pro status with lifetime trips, the quest's boost reads Pro status with the agreement rating, the standing scale counts quality warnings; no ladder repeats another ladder's condition.

[Step 0 - thin base, route-around] As in task 0, trip rows keep the driver-side record (times, distance, duration, multiplier, upfront fare, driver, agreement) and carry the rider-side customer_id, pass_membership_id, net_charged and outstanding_amount as null; no rider charge rows are seeded because no read of this task reaches the rider. The route-inefficiency clawback on the statement names the trip and the trip pay it reverses, and its amount (21.47) is the Wayfare Black recalculated fare on the actual 15.4 mi / 31 min (82.82) less the upfront 61.35, as earnings_evt_adjustments ties the clawback to the rider's fare reduction.

WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. Devon Okafor asks for one thing: cash out as much as he can, now, to his bank debit card. The cashout policy says "The largest instant cashout is worked out only after the earnings statement carries a bonus entry for the most recently ended quest whose trip target was reached and whose payout date has passed." The Denver quest (window 2026-10-12 04:00 to 2026-10-15 04:00 MDT, target 8, reward 80.00) was earned with 9 qualifying trips, its payout date 2026-10-18 has passed and the statement has no bonus entry, so the agent must (1) read the sentence, (2) reconcile the trips against the quest's window, market and status (rejecting the driver-cancelled trip and the trip dropped off at 04:16 on 2026-10-15), (3) settle the reward with four factors, and only then (4) compute the largest cashout with five factors over the balance, today's cashouts, today's tips, the clawback history, the rental and the agreement, and hand the cashout to the driver with its fee.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD.
Root: earnings_ext_max_instant_cashout (on_request; target cash_out_to_debit_card_82ffed45, owner=user).
Prerequisite: earnings_ext_quest_reward_settlement (state_due; target credit_quest_reward_07fce82e, owner=agent).
Edge: kind value_input, gate bal, form state. Prerequisite sentence (cashout policy's own rule, affirmative direction, the way a payouts desk states that a cash figure is fixed only once owed earnings are on the statement): "The largest instant cashout is worked out only after the earnings statement carries a bonus entry for the most recently ended quest whose trip target was reached and whose payout date has passed." Four-point test: (1) "only after" joins this policy's result (the largest instant cashout) to what it waits on; the negated form "is not worked out until the earnings statement carries ..." says the same with nothing added; (2) the waited-on side is a record-visible state (a bonus entry for a given offer on the statement), no action named; (3) no tool, id or code token; (4) scope exactly the condition: only the most recently ended quest, only when its target was reached and its payout date has passed. Exactly one write of this difficulty books a bonus entry: the quest-credit write (the hold-lift writes a payout, the opt-in writes an offer entry, the cashout writes a cashout and fee). Derivation: sentence + records (quest offer ac5861ba-0856-4186-9706-403ce3da9fb9, 9 qualifying trips, no bonus entry, payout date passed) + the quest policy's rule ("Support settles an unpaid quest reward for the account's most recently ended quest ...") -> the one action is crediting that quest's reward. Task 0's sentence is in the negated direction, this one in the affirmative.
Why false at the opening: initial_state.bonus_offers.ac5861ba-0856-4186-9706-403ce3da9fb9.window_end = 2026-10-15 04:00:00 MDT, .target_trip_count = 8; trips 3dda666b-..., 78b8b42a-..., a4dfd963-..., e4036771-..., 468be020-..., bd551c3f-..., c2ae0556-..., 03924458-..., 74f2d33d-... are completed DEN trips dropped off inside the window; no earnings_ledger row carries this bonus_offer_id.
Order: quest settlement, then cashout; one edge.
Deletion sensitivity (actual run): without the quest credit the balance stays 1026.74 and the largest cashout is 574.27 instead of 667.27.
Owner=user problem: the cashout ("Cashing out is the driver's own decision and is done by the driver").

BASE-INVARIANT CARD.
earnings_evt_bonus / within_claim_window (time): anchor offer window_end date 2026-10-15, calendar days, day 1 = 2026-10-16, last day = day 14 = 2026-10-29, not_after, inclusive; frozen_time 2026-10-20 is day 5. Just inside: 2026-10-29; just outside: 2026-10-30.
earnings_evt_bonus / one_payment_per_offer (dedup): no earnings_bonus_credit row with bonus_offer_id ac5861ba-... exists on the statement (the seeded ledger has no bonus entries at all).
earnings_evt_bonus / optin_before_window (authorization): the quest's incentive type is not in optin_required_types (earnings_guarantee only), so no opt-in is needed and the gate holds.
earnings_evt_instant_cashout / active_account: status active. / new_account_wait (time): opened 2026-05-27, wait days 2026-05-28 to 2026-06-03, available from 2026-06-04 (exclusive), frozen 2026-10-20.
Inherited cashout clauses not replaced: at least instant_cashout_min_amount, no more than the available balance, at most 5 cashouts per day (one made today). Replaced by declared overwrite: the daily amount limit and the external fee clause (earnings_evt_instant_cashout) and the status-benefits clause (earnings_pro_tier_evaluation); for the quest, "A quest pays reward_amount once when the qualifying trips reach target_trip_count" and the status-benefits clause.

(DEN, window 2026-10-12 04:00 to 2026-10-15 04:00 MDT, target 8, reward 80.00); qualifying rows: the nine completed DEN trips above; excluded: driver-cancelled trip 7067718b-... (2026-10-14 22:45, never completed) and trip 755fa036-... (dropped off 2026-10-15 04:16, after the window end). The credit writes bonus_offer_id = ac5861ba-.... (0.00), today's tip 1b94268f-78a5-4773-9e0e-3583e3d3ebc2 (12.00), the clawback bfb272cb-5e12-4972-acff-5282e8150ada (-21.47), the rental 6d4b08ea-0d5e-46e0-a5fd-f3324aa380f3 with its weekly charge edfed68c-a590-44b2-87e4-166b29d629c5 (419.00).

FACTOR CARD - earnings_ext_quest_reward_settlement (4: 3 parameter, 1 method; baseline: the stated 80.00 unchanged).
1 pro_boost_rate (parameter; multi-source Pro status AND agreement rating; cross-difficulty driver): Platinum+ with rating >= 4.90 -> 0.10; Silver/Gold with rating >= 4.85 -> 0.05; otherwise 0. World: Gold, 4.88 -> 0.05. Baseline -> 91.00.
2 standing_scale (parameter; cross-difficulty driver standing record): 2+ quality warnings in 6 months -> 0; 1 -> 0.5; none -> 1.0. World: warning 824debb1-... (2026-08-14) = 1; the rating review 24b96c84-... (2026-09-21) is not a warning (near-miss) -> 0.5. Baseline -> 95.00.
3 peak_driver_supplement (parameter; history): trips with peak-trip Pro points this quarter >= 20 -> 12.00; 5 to 19 -> 6.00; fewer -> 0. World: 13 -> 6.00. Baseline -> 87.00.
4 late_settlement_credit (method; date): 7+ days after the payout date -> 2.00 per day; 1 to 6 -> flat 5.00; none -> 0. World: payout date 2026-10-18, settled 2026-10-20, 2 days -> 5.00. Baseline -> 88.00.
Gold: 80.00 x (1 + 0.05 x 0.5) + 6.00 + 5.00 = 93.00. All-baseline 80.00.

FACTOR CARD - earnings_ext_max_instant_cashout (5: 3 parameter, 2 method; baseline: available balance less the status fee, capped at instant_cashout_daily_max_amount less today's cashouts).
1 daily_cashout_limit (parameter; multi-source Pro status AND lifetime trips; cross-difficulty driver): Platinum+ with >= 3000 trips -> 1000.00; Silver/Gold with >= 1000 -> 750.00; otherwise 500.00. World: Gold, 1240 -> 750.00 (limit left 690.00). Baseline (500.00, left 440.00) -> 440.00.
2 cashout_fee (parameter; history): external cashouts today below the status's free allowance -> 0.00; free ones used and Wayfare-card payout method -> 0.40; free ones used otherwise -> status fee. World: 0 external today (today's 60.00 went to the Wayfare card, near-miss), Gold allows 1 -> 0.00. Baseline (0.85) -> 666.42.
3 settling_credits (method; date + history): account open < 3 months -> every credit posted today; 3 to 5 -> only tips posted today; 6+ -> nothing. World: 4 months -> the 12.00 tip. Baseline -> 679.27.
4 risk_method (method; history): fraud disqualification in 3 months -> settled balance x 0.8; else a route-inefficiency clawback in 3 months -> settled balance less the most recent such clawback; else as it stands. World: clawback 21.47 -> 1086.27. Baseline -> 688.74.
5 rental_setaside (parameter; cross-difficulty rental): active rental with a balance due -> that balance due; active with nothing due -> class weekly rate; otherwise nothing. World: active Premium Sedan, due 419.00 -> 419.00. Baseline -> 690.00 (the limit then binds).
Gold: min(690.00, 1119.74 - 12.00 - 21.47 - 419.00 - 0.00) = 667.27. All-baseline: min(440.00, 1119.74 - 0.85) = 440.00. Task-level: multi-source pro_boost_rate and daily_cashout_limit; cross-difficulty pro_boost_rate, standing_scale, daily_cashout_limit, rental_setaside.

WORLD (initial_state) AND WHY EACH ROW EXISTS. The statement starts at Monday 2026-10-12 04:00 MDT: the driver did not drive from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-11, so the 2026-10-06 payout emptied the balance and no 2026-10-13 payout was due, and the quarter's points all sit on the seeded statement (51 = pro_points_balance; 1026.74 = available_balance). earnings_ledger (46): 19 trip pay + 19 points entries, 5 tips (the last added 2026-10-20 07:55 for the 2026-10-19 07:05 trip), the clawback, today's cashout and its fee. bonus_offers (1): the quest. trips (20): 19 completed and 1 driver-cancelled. driver_agreements, driver_standing_events (2), rental_agreements, rental_charges (2). Automatic clauses: the weekly payout of the week 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-18 and the first weekly rental deduction both fall later today (Tuesday) and are not yet due at 08:15; the quest's payout date 2026-10-18 has passed (state_due, carried by this task); no hold, no negative balance, no other open offer.

PERSONA. Devon is direct and tense about a repair bill; he states only the surface goal (cash out as much as possible now to his bank debit card, not the Wayfare card), gives 7205550171 and card 7754 (date of birth 1985-04-27 only as a third detail), mentions this morning's 60-dollar Wayfare-card cashout and the rented Premium Sedan only if asked, accepts in one line if told something had to be taken care of first, makes the cashout himself with exactly the amount and fee given, accepts that part of the balance stays, and hangs up when the cashout is confirmed. No line names a quest, a bonus or anything owed.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate by phone; verify with phone and card; read the account, the statement, the offers, the trips, the agreement, the standing record, the rental and its charges; credit 93.00 to quest ac5861ba-... (agent); unlock the cashout and hand it over; the driver cashes out 667.27 with fee 0.00.

VERIFICATION (actual runs). /tmp/r0056/d4/calc.py with check_compute's evaluator: quest reward 93.00 on the opening world (factor baselines 91.00, 95.00, 87.00, 88.00; all-baseline 80.00); largest cashout 667.27 after the credit (factor baselines 440.00, 666.42, 679.27, 688.74, 690.00; all-baseline 440.00; quest credit skipped 574.27). The gate outputs are recorded in the closing entry.

PLACES MOST EASILY GOT WRONG. Cashing out on the balance before crediting the quest (574.27); counting the trip dropped off at 04:16 or the cancelled trip as qualifying (the target is still met with the 9 that do count, but they are not part of it); counting the rating review as a warning (no boost); treating today's Wayfare-card cashout as external (fee 0.85); holding today's quest credit as settling (the 3-to-5-month tier holds tips only); forgetting the rental's due weekly charge (690.00); using the 500.00 standard limit (440.00).

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT (hidden compute and gold masked): the cashout rule's prerequisite sentence and the statement's missing quest bonus -> settle the quest first; quest rule ladders -> 93.00; cashout rule ladders and order -> 667.27 with fee 0.00. The draft agrees with gold; every ladder is disjoint as written.

DIFFICULTY-LEVEL CLOSING. Coverage: task 0 = {earnings_ext_hold_release_payout, earnings_ext_guarantee_optin_lock}, task 1 = {earnings_ext_quest_reward_settlement, earnings_ext_max_instant_cashout}; union = all four extended policies; tools pairwise disjoint (lift/opt-in vs quest credit/cashout); each task's gold calls one owner=user tool; every edge value_input; draws matched (1 prerequisite each; factors 6/6 and 5/4).

Gate run (repository root, DIFF=env/env_0056_ride_hailing_platform/tasks/driver_earnings_bonuses_and_payouts): check_extended -> EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools -> TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK (4 tools); replay_tasks -> REPLAY OK (0.json 14 actions, closure 93 = initial 93; 1.json 14 actions, closure 75 = initial 75; deterministic, non-vacuous, no Error); check_compute -> COMPUTE OK (0.json: 2 computations, 12 factors, 5 cross-difficulty, history rows 52, branches 34; 1.json: 2 computations, 9 factors, 4 cross-difficulty, history rows 18, branches 26; suite means branches 30.00, steps 14.00; history_rows_max 52, branches_max 34); check_grounding -> GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire -> SCOPE OK; check_cache_diff -> INFO only. check_solvability stops before checking any task with 'identity-verification tool verify_customer_identity must compare the match count against a determinable positive integer K': the frozen blueprint share tool counts matches with `matched += 1` and tests `matched >= 2`, while the gate only recognises `matched = sum(...)`. A scratch copy of the gate whose only change is to read K from that `matched >= 2` comparison reports SOLVABILITY OK for both tasks (0.json: 2 calls, 2 base gates, 60 seed rows; 1.json: 2 calls, 5 base gates, 48 seed rows). check_traceability is deferred until the KB is published. validate_scenario reports for this difficulty only the four 'required document ... not found' errors that rendering resolves; no frozen_time or task_tools token error.
user_scenario:
You are Devon Okafor, a Wayfare Black driver in Denver. It is Tuesday morning, a little after eight, and you are calling driver support from your car. You have a transmission repair bill to settle today at a shop that wants payment up front, so you want to cash out as much as you possibly can from your Wayfare earnings right now, to your regular bank debit card, not the Wayfare card. That is the only thing you are calling about. You are polite but direct, and a little tense about the money.

When the agent asks how to find you, you give your mobile number, which you read out as 7205550171. If the agent asks for another detail to confirm it is you, you give the last four digits of your card, 7754. You give your date of birth, 1985-04-27, only if the agent says it still needs something else.

Only if the agent asks whether you have already cashed out today do you say yes, you moved sixty dollars to your Wayfare debit card at about twenty to eight this morning for gas. If the agent asks about your car, you say you are driving a Wayfare Rentals Premium Sedan you picked up last Thursday. You do not know your balance, your Pro points or how any limits work, and you say so if asked; you are happy for the agent to look at whatever records it needs.

If the agent tells you that something on your account had to be taken care of first, you say that is fine and to go ahead, and you do not ask about anything else. When the agent tells you how much you can cash out and what fee goes with it and hands the cashout over to you, you make the cashout to your debit card yourself straight away with exactly the amount and the fee the agent gave you, and then tell the agent it went through. If the agent explains that part of your balance has to stay on the account, you accept that without arguing. Once the agent confirms the cashout was sent, you thank them and hang up.
